events.title: Signals: AI-driven compute expansion may raise near-term distribution load peaks
events.summary: AI-related compute growth may increase distribution load peaks and demand for transformer spares. Monitoring procurement and substation load telemetry will clarify persistence.

events.title: Scenario: Critical-mineral pressure may constrain transformer deliveries
events.summary: Mineral and shipping stress may lengthen transformer delivery timelines and push procurement toward alternatives. Buyers should watch upstream mineral flows and supplier notices.

events.title: Signal: Rapid uptake of AI-enabled substation automation in distribution pilots
events.summary: AI-enabled automation pilots could change protection workflows and create interoperability needs. Standards and operational validation will be critical to scale safely.

events.title: Signal: Inverter firmware and grid constraints could raise near-term curtailment
events.summary: Inverter firmware interactions with grid constraints could trigger localized curtailment, elevating storage and coordination needs. Firmware validation and coordination will be critical.

events.title: Signal: Storage procurement frictions may increase reliance on fossil peakers for short-term reliability
events.summary: Storage procurement delays could lead to short-term reliance on fossil peakers for data-center resilience, raising emissions and fuel logistics needs.

events.title: Signal: Early indicators of export-control posture shifts on certain minerals
events.summary: Administrative signals indicate possible tightening of mineral export controls; manufacturers and buyers may face higher sourcing risk if action proceeds.

events.title: Signal: OEMs indicate capacity expansion plans but with conditional timelines
events.summary: OEM capacity expansion is planned but dependent on material and financing conditions; actual relief for equipment lead times depends on follow-through.

events.title: Signal: Corporate PPAs tied to data-center growth may shift renewables procurement timing
events.summary: Concentrated corporate PPAs for data centers may redirect renewable project financing and interconnection priorities, influencing regional grid planning.

events.title: Signal: Standards push for HVDC connector interoperability is gaining momentum
events.summary: HVDC connector standardization may improve long-term interoperability but could prompt near-term design rework and certification delays for manufacturers.

events.title: Signal: Predictive-maintenance AI adoption may increase spare-parts stocking even as outage rates fall
events.summary: Predictive-maintenance AI may lower outage risk but raise spare-part procurement demand; inventory and supplier responsiveness will determine net resilience gains.
